{{Top|leg}}
'''Seascapes''' were [[City/Legends|cities]] built on huge platforms constructed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pelagon]] that sat above the world's [[Water/Legends|watery]] surface. During the height of Pelagon's power, over twenty of the artificial platforms existed, each sprawling for dozens of [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. All but two of the platforms were destroyed when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[House Mecetti]] assaulted the planet. Around the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], six platforms were in operation, having been rebuilt from scavenged parts. Pelagon's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Pelagar]], was the largest platform reaching over twenty kilometers in diameter.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
